name: Solace II
description: A densely developed temperate world whose equatorial industrial belt supplies propulsion, fabrication and logistics businesses across the region.
visualDescription: Blue-green temperate world with bright equatorial city belts and extensive orbital traffic.

image.promptDescription: Temperate industrial planet seen from orbit, blue-green oceans and continents crossed by bright equatorial urban belts.

name: Solace III
description: A cold, sparsely inhabited world used for specialist mineral processing, bulk storage and hazardous industrial work separated from Solace II's major population centres.
visualDescription: Pale grey-blue cold world with isolated industrial lights and large surface processing zones.

image.promptDescription: Cold sparsely inhabited industrial planet with pale terrain, thin atmosphere and isolated mineral-processing complexes.

name: Varda Prime
description: A cool oceanic world with carefully controlled settlement zones and extensive biological research infrastructure.
visualDescription: Deep ocean world with cool cloud bands, scattered island settlements and small clean orbital stations.

image.promptDescription: Cool oceanic research planet seen from orbit, dark blue oceans, dense clouds and restrained scientific settlement lights.
